title: Create Your First HTML Page
prompt: Which part of a basic HTML document contains the page content readers interact with?
objective: Create a valid minimal document and include a title, one h1, and one paragraph.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: document structure, doctype, title, headings.
hints: Use a document skeleton and identify the part that holds headings and paragraphs.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: ['Use a document skeleton and identify the part that holds headings and paragraphs.'] Required structural evidence: , , <h1>, <p>.

retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
